text:
elaine: Heads up—noticed a weird interaction between scoped roles + per-route quotas and our routing telemetry. When a request is served by fallback model, quota attribution and trace sampling are inconsistent. Repro steps below.
sam: Can you paste the minimal repro? Is this only on Dedicated?
elaine: repro: tenant=acme, role=scoped:billing, route=/v1/generate, quota=1000/min. With quota exhausted on primary pool we fallback to shared pool. Logs show request routed to shared but trace shows tenant=null and sampling=0. Example log:
```
[2026-03-19T18:12:03Z] route=/v1/generate tenant=acme pool=shared model=x-small trace_id= - sampling=0 quota_token=none
```
anya: whoa. So telemetry isn't being annotated when fallback happens?
kevin: likely header lost during proxy hop. We recently added `x-tenant-scope` header in route-level router but shared pool uses legacy proxy that strips unknown headers.
matt: UX note—this makes Console charts look like requests disappearing. Folks see quotas not aligning with actual inference.
elaine: exactly. Customers on enterprise Dedicated noticed gaps—billing vs console mismatch.
sam: short-term: can we set sampling at edge before hop? i.e., had the router inject `x-sampling=1` and `x-tenant=acme` into request body? feasible?
kevin: edge set is doable but we'd need to change how fallback proxy forwards headers. I'm worried about header bloat and KMS/HSM PII leakage.
anya: product ask: we need an interim Console flag that shows "fallback accounted" overlay, else support tickets blow up. Could be a toggle per-tenant.
elaine: proposed fix list:
- patch fallback proxy to preserve `x-tenant-scope` and `x-request-id`
- set sampling decision at router (pre-hop)
- Console: add "fallback accounted" indicator on per-route telemetry
- long-term: route affinity so fallback doesn't lose context
sam: API change: add `X-Redwood-Scope` canonical header for all internal hops. Minimal surface.
kevin: +1 but we'll need to sanitize values (no PII). Also add strict allowlist in proxy.
matt: for Console mockup: small pill next to route name: `Fallbacks: 12` with tooltip `Requests served by fallback pool; telemetry may be incomplete until vX`
anya: can ops toggle sampling override? we should ship toggle in next patch release.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: fallback-proxy-fix -> canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC, rollback policy 15m
sam: ok I'll draft the API RFC and link the proxy PR. Elaine can you open a support playbook entry so CS knows how to interpret charts?
elaine: will do. also adding customer impacted list: Acme, BetaCo.
kevin: I'll own proxy PR + tests. Sam: ping me on the RFC.
anya: thanks team. +1 on quick Console visual and support notes.
matt: I'll drop a tiny mock in Figma and link here once ready.
elaine: thanks all. filing follow-ups: #1 RFC (sam), #2 proxy PR (kevin), #3 Console overlay (matt), #4 support playbook (elaine).
